baseline: v195 (v194 + word-level mom detection in male SPK segments)

label_to_gt.SPEAKER_01: SPK_1 (dad on phone — Sean 부르는 어른)

stages: Stage 1: LightASD face cluster speaking score → identify speaking face clusters
Stage 2: ERes2NetV2 voice cross-check: speaking face cluster's audio voice vs parent SPK centroid. If sim < 0.55 → suspicious window
Stage 3: Focused NeMo re-diarize on suspicious window ±3s with min_speakers=2 → precise mom utterance boundary

key_models.InsightFace_antelopev2: R100 ArcFace 512-dim face embedding for clustering
key_models.ERes2NetV2: 192-dim voice embedding for parent-SPK voice cross-check

pipeline_v190.generic_property: No hard-coded time ranges. Applied automatically to any video where face is visible during mom/sub-speaker interjection.
